purpose: Formal source catalog and integrity documentation for the RCB Auction Intelligence Engine. Complements the operational fetch registry in configs/data_sources.yaml. Per-file retrieval timestamps and SHA-256 hashes for each fetched artifact are recorded separately at fetch time in the gitignored data/raw/**/manifest.json provenance log via src/ingestion/manifest.py.

sources.known_limitations: Lacks spatial ball-tracking coordinates and explicit fielding chance logs.

sources.license: Compiled for non-commercial research per dataset author; not an official BCCI/IPL publication
sources.known_limitations: Schema drift across years; no retention/RTM status field; 2013 prices in unconverted native USD; community-compiled, not independently audited by BCCI/IPL. Official iplt20.com/ESPNcricinfo automated fetch returned S3 AccessDenied / Akamai edge blocks as of 2026-09-10.

sources.format: Web HTML tables and official PDF press releases
sources.scope: 2014-2025 verified on portal; 2008-2013 unverified on web portal
sources.license: Site terms of use apply; no explicit open-source data license documented
sources.known_limitations: Inconsistent web table layout across seasons; automated fetch blocked (bot detection) as of 2026-09-10, so used only for manual spot-check cross-verification, not primary ingestion.
